compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "Selected Exams" and is designed to allow users to select the exams they are preparing for. The main content includes a grid of buttons, each representing a different exam category. The available options are:

1. SSC (selected)
2. Banking
3. IAS
4. GATE
5. State Level
6. CLAT
7. Railways
8. Insurance
9. TET Exams
10. NDA
11. Defence

At the bottom of the screen, there is a blue "Proceed" button for users to continue after making their selection. Below this button, there is a note indicating that users can add more exams later. The screen also includes a language option ("ENGLISH") and a back arrow to return to the previous screen.
